data.description: 暴雨倾盆的龙门城际列车站台边缘，陈撑着一把透明雨伞静静等候在雨幕之中，雨滴在伞面上敲击出密集的鼓点。看到列车舱门打开走出的你，她快步上前将伞倾斜过去——「路上辛苦了。车已经备好，我们直接回近卫局。」
data.lighting: wet reflections and dim platform lights
data.promptProse: She steps toward the opening train doors and tilts her clear umbrella over the arriving viewer outside the frame. Dim platform light catches rain on the canopy and reflects across the wet paving.
data.title: 陈 · 雨夜车站
data.animaCaption: She tilts the umbrella toward the arriving viewer outside the frame.
